lines.text: Full time: Pellmoor Harriers 1, Zennmark Town 1. The event log is frozen for the report.

Reading minutes 75 to 85: changes in the 75th minute, then Arno Quenrick equalises.
Drafted 6 sentences for the headline report.
Rewrote sentence 3 with the Fact Gate's reason in hand.
Struck sentence 3. It said 2 shots on target; the log says 4.
Rechecked all 6 sentences: every number, name and minute agrees with the log.
Flagged sentence 5 for a person: the log cannot show a medical assessment.
Wrote the Greek, Spanish and French editions; names stay in Latin script.
Wrote the easy-read edition: short sentences, one idea each, numbers as digits.
Rechecked 24 translated and easy-read sentences and screened every name: all fictional, all on the roster.
Waiting for the club media officer to approve that exact hash.
